adc.sample_rate_MSPS.value: >=10 MSPS per channel, both channels simultaneously

input.voltage_range_V.value: -10 V to +10 V full scale at the BNC connector, DC-coupled (DC coupling ASSUMED)

capture.depth_s.value: >=0.1 s per channel at 10 MSPS, both channels (>=1,000,000 samples/channel, >=2,000,000 total)

capture.buffer_MB.value: >=4 MB (32 Mbit) on-board buffer: 2 ch x 10 MSPS x 0.1 s x 2 B (12-bit in 16-bit word); recommended 256 Mbit x16 SDR SDRAM (32 MB)

data.raw_rate_MBps.value: 40 MB/s raw (2 ch x 10 MSPS x 2 B, 16-bit words); 30 MB/s if 12-bit packed

usb.throughput_MBps.value: Design for >=30 MB/s USB 2.0 HS bulk readout; real-time 40 MB/s streaming NOT guaranteed (practical HS bulk ~35-42 MB/s, host-dependent) -> capture-to-buffer is the guaranteed mode

power.vbus_voltage_V.value: Operate from 4.4 V to 5.25 V at the board USB connector (USB 2.0 host port 4.75-5.25 V minus cable/hub drop)

power.vbus_current_mA.value: <=450 mA steady-state total VBUS draw (90% of USB 2.0 500 mA high-power limit); USB-C Type-C Current advertisements are headroom only, not relied upon

power.preconfig_current_mA.value: <=100 mA VBUS draw before the host sets configuration (one USB 2.0 unit load); analog front end, ADC, FPGA core activity and SDRAM rails must be power-gated/held off until configured

power.suspend_current_mA.value: <=2.5 mA total VBUS draw in USB suspend; all gated rails off, only USB bridge + always-on regulators/pull-ups remain (FT232H suspend current to be verified)

power.vbus_capacitance_uF.value: <=10 uF directly on VBUS at attach; any additional bulk capacitance must sit behind a soft-start/load switch (USB 2.0 inrush limit)

clock.jitter_ps_rms.value: <=5 ps rms total jitter at the ADC clock pin (SNR_jitter >= 74 dB at f_in = 5 MHz requires t_j <= 6.3 ps; 5 ps gives margin)

input.impedance.value: 1 MOhm || ~20 pF per channel at the BNC (ASSUMED: oscilloscope-input standard so passive 1x/10x probes compensate correctly)

input.overvoltage_V.value: Survive +/-30 V continuous at the BNC with no damage (ASSUMED: protects against probe set to the wrong range); protection must not degrade the 1 MOhm input impedance or the 3 MHz bandwidth

analog.bandwidth_MHz.value: -3 dB bandwidth >= 3 MHz; anti-alias filter >= 40 dB attenuation at >= 7.5 MHz (folds to 2.5 MHz at 10 MSPS) (ASSUMED: brief states no bandwidth)

analog.enob_bits.value: >=10.5 ENOB end-to-end (connector to digital word) at f_in = 1 MHz (ASSUMED: brief states only 12-bit resolution)

analog.dc_accuracy.value: Post-calibration gain error <=1 %, offset <=+/-20 mV referred to input, using per-channel gain/offset constants stored in the FT232H 93LC56 EEPROM user area and applied host-side. Uncalibrated (relaxed, sets calibration range only): gain error <=3 %, offset <=+/-150 mV RTI (LTC2290 figures UNVERIFIED; check against datasheet) (DECIDED 2026-10-06, user option (a))

power.aon_suspend_allocation_mA.value: <=1.75 mA architecture allocation cap for everything on VBUS in suspend (FT232H <=1.2 mA, D+ pull-up 0.2 mA, 3V3_AON LDO Iq <=0.1 mA, bus switch <=0.02 mA, 93LC56 <=0.01 mA, load-switch/converter off-leakage <=0.01 mA, ESD/TVS/cap leakage <=0.05 mA); no LED, divider or conducting pull on 3V3_AON

power.rail_allocation_mA.value: Per-rail load allocations (sum to ~342 mA at VBUS=4.4 V, <=450 mA): 3V3_AON 61 mA (FT232H <=60 mA max operating current); 3V3_D 205 mA total (FPGA I/O 25, SDRAM avg 70, flash 2, LEDs 3, 1V2_FPGA LDO 30, 1V8_A LDO 60, 1V8_D LDO 15); 3V3_CLK 15 mA; +5V_A 20 mA, -5V_A 15 mA via +/-6 V converter (eta>=75 %); buck eta>=88 %; contingency 25 mA. Pre-config only 3V3_AON live (~61 mA <=100 mA). Ungated capacitance <=9 uF (<=2.2 uF on VBUS + <=6.8 uF on 3V3_AON); gated bulk <=100 uF behind >=3 ms soft start.
